claims.text: Java SE 21 documents that applications obtain a ServiceLoader through load methods; a module consumer declares uses, a provider module declares provides, and class-path providers are declared by META-INF/services/<service fully qualified binary name> with one provider name per line.

Java SE 21 documents lazy provider locating and instantiation, a cache of loaded providers, stream inspection/filtering through Provider before get, reload clearing the provider cache, and discarding iterators or streams after reload.

Java SE 21 documents ServiceConfigurationError when locating, loading, or instantiating a provider fails; it also specifies class-loader visibility requirements for class-path provider classes and says ServiceLoader instances are not safe for concurrent use by multiple threads.

Java SE 21 documents that a module service provider may supply a service instance through a public static no-argument provider method whose return type is assignable to the service, in which case the provider type itself need not be assignable; absent that method, a public no-argument provider constructor is used and the provider type must be assignable.

findings: JDK 21 ServiceLoader API 与候选及证据映射一致，覆盖 uses/provides、classpath 配置、provider method/构造器规则、懒发现/缓存/reload、stream、错误和并发边界。
候选直接覆盖来源变体并满足 mechanism 题型的参与者、流程、状态、开销、版本和故障边界要求。
多 provider 的选择、启动校验和受信任 provider 是明确工程建议，未伪装为 JDK 自动保证。
